newsitem.title: GUYANA: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS, OPT TO BAT IN FINAL TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS, OPT TO BAT IN FINAL TEST.

text.p: India won the toss and opted to bat on the opening day of the fifth and final test against West Indies on Thursday.
West Indies, who lead the series 1-0 after their 38-run win in the third test, are unchanged from the rain-ruined drawn fourth test in Antigua.
India have made two changes. Experienced opener Navjot Sidhu has replaced Vangipurappu Laxman and fast bowler Dodda Ganesh comes in for batsman Saurav Ganguly.
The match was starting in sunny conditions.
West Indies - Sherwin Campbell, Stuart Williams, Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Brian Lara, Carl Hooper, Roland Holder, Courtney Browne, Ian Bishop, Curtly Ambrose, Courtney Walsh (captain), Franklyn Rose.
India - Navjot Sidhu, Ajay Jadeja, Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, Nayan Mongia, Anil Kumble, Venkatesh Prashad, Dodda Ganesh, Abey Kuruvilla, Sunil Joshi.
